raffle_numbers_reservation_consistent.name: raffle_numbers_reservation_consistent
raffle_numbers_reservation_consistent.value:
("raffle_numbers"."status" = 'reserved' and "raffle_numbers"."reserved_until" is not null and "raffle_numbers"."reservation_id" is not null)
        or ("raffle_numbers"."status" <> 'reserved' and "raffle_numbers"."reserved_until" is null and "raffle_numbers"."reservation_id" is null)

raffles_dates_order.name: raffles_dates_order
raffles_dates_order.value: "raffles"."starts_at" is null or "raffles"."ends_at" is null or "raffles"."ends_at" > "raffles"."starts_at"

buyer_contacts_has_contact.name: buyer_contacts_has_contact
buyer_contacts_has_contact.value: "buyer_contacts"."email" is not null or "buyer_contacts"."phone" is not null
